phase2_rejections.reason: Actual GRPO reward is continuation-token log probability plus optional length/think-format penalties, with model/self state and batch returns. BBH Boolean expressions appear only as downstream evaluation of information gain. Not a bare Boolean correctness reward endpoint.

The custom boolean reward scores a predicted logical formula against a ground_truth_list of structural expressions. It returns a dict of score/acc/parse metadata, not a scalar True/False correctness callback. Function name Boolean does not establish Boolean-token answer domain.
